hypothesis: A conservative fraction of genuine same-book pregame market log-odds movement contains incremental information about the 2025 winner decision beyond the governed frozen F-ST benchmark, while most games remain effectively unchanged.

target_sample.universe: the exact 272 regular-season game_ids in the chronology-clean F-ST 2025 benchmark
target_sample.reason_for_scope: The newly qualified public historical market archive covers 2025 with genuine timestamped snapshots. Equivalent multi-season book-level path history is not qualified.
target_sample.missing_candidate3_market_path_rows: retain row and set Candidate 3 probability equal to F-ST probability

historical_blinding_limitation.reason: 2025 NFL outcomes and some game identities were already known from prior Candidate 1/Candidate 2 and LevLine research before this Candidate 3 program began.
historical_blinding_limitation.interpretation: The architecture was selected from prior negative adaptive evidence, PIT source qualification, and external literature, not from Candidate 3 path/outcome results. Any favorable historical result can be at most promising and requires prospective validation.

required_pit: sportsbook_updated_at <= captured_at when sportsbook_updated_at is present
no later state backfill into an earlier band

timestamp_bands.selection_within_band: for each sportsbook, select the latest qualifying captured_at inside the band

market_transform.book_state: home no-vig probability paired from home and away h2h outcomes at the same sportsbook and captured_at

mathematical_architecture.structural_prior: chronology-clean season-forward F-ST probability for the identical 2025 game_id
mathematical_architecture.lambda_rationale: Conservative shrinkage: F-ST already contains a market component and the historical path archive is coarse. Candidate 3 therefore incorporates only one quarter of the observed same-book log-odds innovation rather than treating the full movement as independent information.
mathematical_architecture.missingness: fail closed to exact F-ST probability

primary_feature_family: signed same-book log-odds innovation from early band to lock band

controls.raw_lock_market: same archive, primary lock band, consensus level only
controls.component_resolved: unchanged season-forward L2 market+four-component stack from existing LevLine 4 evidence
controls.probability_only_update: the primary Candidate 3 itself is a continuous probability update; winner changes are emergent at 0.5, not separately gated

robustness_grid.rule: Every cell is reported; no best-cell promotion.

primary_metric: paired straight-up accuracy difference versus F-ST on all 272 identical rows

paired_inference.mcnemar: exact two-sided on discordant winner correctness

adversarial_tests: single-book dependence by leave-one-book-out path recomputation
timestamp-window sensitivity across all 12 preregistered cells
minimum-book coverage sensitivity as descriptive only; no alternate minimum is promotable

success_bands.REJECTED: Primary Candidate 3 does not exceed F-ST winner accuracy, or PIT/source integrity fails.
success_bands.INCONCLUSIVE: Primary accuracy is positive but evidence is too sparse, concentrated, fragile, or uncertain to satisfy the promising band.
success_bands.PROMISING_REQUIRES_PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATIO: Primary gains at least 3 net winners over F-ST; has at least 7 winner switches and switch win rate >=0.60; no single week supplies >50% of net gain; no single team deletion makes the net gain negative; at least 9/12 preregistered grid cells are nonnegative and at least 6/12 are positive; probability quality does not trigger a +0.0025 Brier deterioration alert; PIT integrity passes. This still cannot constitute production validation from one known-outcome historical season.
success_bands.PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED: Not attainable in Candidate 3 historical evaluation.

stopping_rule: Run the frozen primary candidate, all frozen controls, all 12 robustness cells, and the preregistered adversarial suite exactly once in canonical CI. Do not add features or retune lambda/window choices after target results.
prohibited_data: closing lines used to reconstruct missing earlier states
completed 2026 outcomes for candidate design or evaluation

advancement.if_promising: prospective preregistered shadow validation is required before any promotion consideration
advancement.if_inconclusive_or_rejected: close Candidate 3 and stop; do not begin Candidate 4
